title: April 29, 2024 Notification on the Corporate Governance Code-2018 regarding inclusion of at least 1 (one) female independent director in the Board of Directors of the company.
text:
Bangladesh

Securities and Exchange Commission

E-6/c, Sher-e-Bangla Nagar Administrative Area

Agargaon, Dhaka

www.sec.gov.bd

Directive

No. BSEC/SMMID/44-231/107(7)-1886

Dated 20 May 2024

Inexercise of the powers conferred by section 2OA of the Securities and Exchange

Ordinance, 1969(Ordinance No. XVIl of 1969), the Bangladesh Securities and Exchange

Commission issues the following direction to Dhaka Stock Exchange PLC and

Chittagong

Stock Exchange PLC

regarding Dhaka Stock Exchange (TREC Holder's

margin) Regulations 2013 and Chitagong

Stock Exchange (TREC Holder's margin)

Regulations 2013:-

1) The Stock Exchanges

shall allow ICB Securities Trading Company Limited (ISTCL)

toexercise 'Non-MarginLimit' amountingBDT. 500.00 million;

2) Investment

Corporation of Bangladesh

(ICB) or ISTCL shall provide an eligible

guarantee/corporate

guarantee to the stock exchanges

in this regard.

This shall have immediateeffect.

By order of the Bangladesh Securities and

Exchange Commission

Professor'ShibliRubayat-UI-Islam

Chairman
